newsitem.title: Netherlands: DUTCH BONDS CLOSE BARELY CHANGED.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH BONDS CLOSE BARELY CHANGED.

text.p: * DUTCH STATE LOANS PRICES BID YIELDS
* DSLs versus Bunds (pvs close) *DSL curve (pvs close)
* Dutch bonds closed flat to slightly higher after ticking up
in late trade to erase earlier modest losses. Dealers said EU's
Amsterdam summit had little effect. Debt markets expected to
drift close to current levels in coming weeks with volatility
increasing as U.S. FOMC meeting approaches on July 1 and 2.

Debt markets were expected to drift along close to current levels in the coming weeks with volatility increasing as the July 1 and 2 meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee to consider U.S. interest rates approaches.
"I think the possibility of another U.S. rate rise has becoming less likely. I think that when the Fed raised rates in March it was meant to last for the whole year," a dealer said.
Dealers were largely dismissive of recent reports of strong Dutch growth stoking inflation and pushing up bond yields.
"The very tight supply of new government bonds will prevent Dutch yields from creeping up too much," said one.
